lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਲਿਵ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanee liv aape laae guramukh sadaa samaaleeai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the love, and He Himself is the embrace; the Gurmukh contemplates Him forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak evad daataa so kiu manahu visaareeai ||28||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, why forget such a Great Giver from the mind? ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee agan udar mahi taisee baahar maaiaa ||
lines.translation: As is the fire within the womb, so is Maya outside.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਭ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹੀ ਕਰਤੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa agan sabh iko jehee karatai khel rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The fire of Maya is one and the same; the Creator has staged this play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa ja(n)miaa paravaar bhalaa bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: According to His Will, the child is born, and the family is very pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਵ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਲਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਮਰੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: liv chhuRakee lagee trisanaa maaiaa amar varataaiaa ||
lines.translation: Love for the Lord wears off, and the child becomes attached to desires; the script of Maya runs its course.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh maaiaa jit har visarai mohu upajai bhaau doojaa laaiaa ||
lines.translation: This is Maya, by which the Lord is forgotten; emotional attachment and love of duality well up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak gur parasaadee jinaa liv laagee tinee viche maaiaa paaiaa ||29||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, those who enshrine love for the Lord find Him, in the midst of Maya. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aap amulak hai mul na paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is priceless; His worth cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਰਹੇ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mul na paaiaa jaai kisai vitahu rahe lok vilalaai ||
lines.translation: His worth cannot be estimated, even though people have grown weary of trying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa satigur je milai tis no sir saupeeai vichahu aap jaai ||
lines.translation: If you meet such a True Guru, offer your head to Him; your selfishness and conceit will be eradicated from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis daa jeeu tis mil rahai har vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: Your soul belongs to Him; remain united with Him, and the Lord will come to dwell in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: har aap amulak hai bhaag tinaa ke naanakaa jin har palai paai ||30||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is priceless; very fortunate are those, O Nanak, who attain to the Lord. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har raas meree man vanajaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is my capital; my mind is the merchant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har raas meree man vanajaaraa satigur te raas jaanee ||
lines.translation: The Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant; through the True Guru, I know my capital.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਹੁ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਖਟਿਹੁ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har nit japihu jeeahu laahaa khatihu dihaaRee ||
lines.translation: Meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul, and you shall collect your profits daily.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu dhan tinaa miliaa jin har aape bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: This wealth is obtained by those who are pleasing to the Lord's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak har raas meree man hoaa vanajaaraa ||31||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਰਸਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: e rasanaa too an ras raach rahee teree piaas na jaai ||
lines.translation: O my tongue, you are engrossed in other tastes, but your thirsty desire is not quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: piaas na jaai horat kitai jichar har ras palai na paai ||
lines.translation: Your thirst shall not be quenched by any means, until you attain the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇ ਪਲੈ ਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras paai palai peeai har ras bahuR na trisanaa laagai aai ||
lines.translation: If you do obtain the subtle essence of the Lord, and drink in this essence of the Lord, you shall not be troubled by desire again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu har ras karamee paaeeai satigur milai jis aai ||
lines.translation: This subtle essence of the Lord is obtained by good karma, when one comes to meet with the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਭਿ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak hor an ras sabh veesare jaa har vasai man aai ||32||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, all other tastes and essences are forgotten, when the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: e sareeraa meriaa har tum mahi jot rakhee taa too jag mahi aaiaa ||
lines.translation: O my body, the Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jot rakhee tudh vich taa too jag mahi aaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਉਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape maataa aape pitaa jin jeeu upaai jagat dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is your mother, and He Himself is your father; He created the created beings, and revealed the world to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਾ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਚਲਤੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee bujhiaa taa chalat hoaa chalat nadaree aaiaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, some understand, and then it's a show; it seems like just a show.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak srisat kaa mool rachiaa jot raakhee taa too jag mahi aaiaa ||33||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, He laid the foundation of the Universe, and infused His Light, and then you came into the world. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗਮੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man chaau bhaiaa prabh aagam suniaa ||
lines.translation: My mind has become joyful, hearing of God's coming.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਉ ਸਖੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)gal gaau sakhee grihu ma(n)dar baniaa ||
lines.translation: Sing the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions; my household has become the Lord's Mansion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਏ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gaau ma(n)gal nit sakheee sog dookh na viaapae ||
lines.translation: Sing continually the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions, and sorrow and suffering will not afflict you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਪਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur charan laage din sabhaage aapanaa pir jaapae ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that day, when I am attached to the Guru's feet and meditate on my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahat baanee gur sabad jaanee har naam har ras bhogo ||
lines.translation: I have come to know the unstruck sound current and the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, the Lord's Name.
